$comment: Reviewed exceptions for supabase/tests/policy-lint.test.ts. Every entry needs a reason. Adding one requires a human reviewer on the PR.

anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.public_calendar: Share-token page; returns dates only when the admin published the calendar
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.public_property: Share-token page; returns the chata name and two flags
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.public_manual: Share-token page; returns PUBLIC sections only
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.public_flag_manual_section: Share-token page; capped at 20 open flags per section
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.public_guest_link: Guest link page; token check, returns name and address the family chose to share
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.public_guest_availability: Guest link page; dates and status only
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.submit_guest_request: Guest form; token check, validation, rate limits
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.submit_institutional_request: Institution form; token check, validation, rate limits
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.current_account_id: Caller-scoped helper; returns null for anon
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.current_member_id: Caller-scoped helper; returns null for anon
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.audit_decisions: Trigger function; cannot be called directly
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.guard_public_form: Trigger function; cannot be called directly
anonExecutableDefinerFunctions.invitation_preview: Invitation page; token check, returns names, role and a masked email only

definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.is_admin_only_file: Returns a boolean used inside a storage policy
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.account_plan: Returns a plan id; execute limited to authenticated
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.plan_limit: Returns a plan limit; execute limited to authenticated
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.invitations_token_guard: Trigger function; reads other accounts' tokens only to refuse a collision
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.overlap_peak_guests: Internal helper of booking_defaults; no execute grant to anon or authenticated
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.account_founder: Internal helper of convert_account_to_institution and set_member_role; no execute grant to anon or authenticated
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.notify_on_booking: Trigger function (0038); notifications for a stay the caller's own write changed
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.notify_on_handover: Trigger function (0038); passes the leaving checklist on. handovers.member_id is the inserter's own member unless an admin writes it (policy in 0038), and the author's name is read only within the cottage's account
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.notify_on_guest_request: Trigger function (0038); tells the requester about the decision. requester_user_id and source are frozen by guest_request_decision_stamp (0034), so the recipient can't be redirected to another sign-in
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.notify_on_ownership_offer: Trigger function (0038); tells the member offered the account
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.notify_on_invitation: Trigger function (0038); e-mails the invitee. Fires only on inserts the invitations policy allows (admins of the account); cottage and inviter names are read only within new.account_id
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.notify_leaving_checklist: Internal helper of the 0038 triggers; no execute grant to anon or authenticated
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.next_stay_after_handover: Internal helper of the 0038 triggers and handover_next_recipient; no execute grant to anon or authenticated
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.forward_leaving_checklist_to: Internal helper of notify_on_booking; no execute grant to anon or authenticated
definerFunctionsWithoutCallerCheck.notify_enqueue: Internal helper of the 0038 triggers and functions; no execute grant to anon or authenticated (revoked in 0038, proven in t053-rls.test.ts)

anonTablePrivileges.consent_log:INSERT: Cookie banner logs the choice before sign-in
